_doc: Abstract nouns and homographs the image model renders wrong most often (foil->sword, nail->finger, bat->mammal-vs-baseball, page->cloud). There is NO automated wrong-object gate (that needs vision); instead these words MUST be eyeballed on a contact sheet after (re)generation. Words already pinned by an explicit prompt live in concrete_prompts.json. Add a word here the first time the model draws it wrong so future rebuilds get a review flag.
